items.title: The R15,000 Website Myth for SA Small Businesses
items.content: Most South African small business owners are convinced they need to spend R15k–R30k and wait 6 weeks for an agency to build a website. In reality, 85% of their traffic comes from mobile phones looking for 3 things: what you do, how much it costs, and a 1-tap WhatsApp link. LaunchGremlin replaces bloated agency delays with instant, high-converting digital storefronts.

items.title: Why 85% of SA Customers Bounce on Slow Websites
items.content: In South Africa, mobile data is precious and connectivity varies. If a local business website takes more than 2 seconds to load, 85% of mobile visitors tap back. LaunchGremlin storefronts are built with zero-bloat modern tech that loads in 0.3s on 3G/4G connections.

items.title: Why Paper Business Cards & PDF Menus Kill WhatsApp Inquiries
items.content: Paper cards get lost in car cup holders and PDF menus take 10MB of data to download. Instant digital business cards load in 0.3s, have a 1-tap WhatsApp chat button, and save contact details directly to a phone book in 1 click.

items.title: The 3 Essentials Every Local SA Business Storefront Needs
items.content: Small business websites in South Africa fail because they hide what they do behind buzzwords. To convert visitors into inquiries, you only need 3 things: 1) What you do in plain language, 2) Starting prices / clear packages, and 3) A direct 1-tap WhatsApp booking link.
